plot: An unsuccessful writer discovers a secret drug that dramatically sharpens his mind and transforms his life. As he pursues success, wealth, and a fresh start, dangerous people and the drug’s risks begin closing in around him.

title: The Medium
plot: A documentary team follows a shaman and her family as unusual behavior suggests a young woman may be inheriting a spiritual role. As the situation grows more disturbing, the family faces a frightening mystery surrounding the source of the possession.

title: Wrong Turn
plot: A young woman and her friends set out for a wilderness hike, but ignore warnings and stray from the marked route. They soon enter territory controlled by a secluded mountain community, forcing the group to confront deadly dangers and their own assumptions about the people they encounter.

title: Strange Darling
plot: A twisted one-night encounter spirals into a violent cat-and-mouse chase involving a suspected serial killer. Told through six chapters presented out of order, the story steadily challenges expectations while two central figures navigate danger, deception, and a disturbing relationship.

title: Crank: High Voltage
plot: A nearly indestructible hitman wakes to discover that his heart has been replaced with a battery-powered device. As he hunts those responsible, he must find increasingly extreme ways to keep the artificial heart charged and stay alive.

crew.name: Brian Taylor
crew.role: Screenplay, Director, Executive Producer, "A" Camera Operator

title: Orphan: First Kill
plot: After escaping a psychiatric facility in Estonia, a dangerous adult impersonates the missing daughter of a wealthy American family. As suspicions grow and her disguise begins to unravel, she faces a fiercely protective mother determined to defend her household from the murderous “child.”

title: Immaculate
plot: A devout nun begins a new life at a remote convent in the Italian countryside, where an initially warm welcome gives way to growing unease. As disturbing events unfold and the sanctuary’s hidden purpose comes into view, she must confront a terrifying threat tied to her faith and her own body.

title: How to Have Sex
plot: Three teenage friends take a party-heavy holiday in Greece, expecting drinking, dancing and new experiences to make it the best summer of their lives. As one girl pursues her first sexual experience, peer pressure and an unsettling encounter force her to question friendship, consent and what she truly wants.

title: Elevation
plot: In a post-apocalyptic world, survivors live at high elevations to avoid giant insect-like creatures that cannot cross the boundary. When a young boy needs life-saving supplies, a father joins two companions on a dangerous journey into the creature-infested lowlands.

title: Project Wolf Hunting
plot: Aboard a cargo ship carrying dangerous convicts under armed guard, a carefully planned escape erupts into a violent riot. As the fugitives fight to survive and maintain control, a terrifying force unleashed from below deck turns their brutal struggle into an even more dangerous nightmare.

title: 9½ Weeks
plot: An art gallery assistant becomes involved with a mysterious man in an intense, impersonal affair built around elaborate sexual games. As the relationship deepens, his controlling behavior and emotional distance begin to challenge her boundaries, independence, and understanding of what she wants.

title: Dog 51
plot: In a near-future Paris divided into three social zones, a predictive AI controls law enforcement. After its creator is assassinated, a highly regarded agent and a weary police officer must work together to investigate the murder and question the system they serve.

title: Killer Elite
plot: A retired special-operations agent is pulled back into the dangerous world of contract killings when his longtime mentor is taken hostage. To secure his release, he must track down elite operatives across several countries while evading a determined former agent.

title: Beauty and the Beast
plot: After losing his fortune, a merchant finds himself bound to a fearsome creature after taking a rose from an enchanted castle. His compassionate daughter offers to take his place, becoming drawn into the castle’s mystery as fear gradually gives way to affection and danger threatens the fragile bond.

title: When Evil Lurks
plot: Two brothers discover a demonic infection spreading from a nearby farmhouse and try to remove its host from their rural community. When they fail to follow the required rules, their actions unleash a rapidly growing wave of possessions, forcing them to confront an evil that can appear almost anywhere.

crew.name: Andrés Borghi
crew.role: Visual Effects Art Director, VFX Supervisor, VFX Artist

title: Lawless
plot: During the Great Depression, three brothers run a hidden bootlegging operation in rural Virginia. Their uneasy arrangement with local authorities collapses when a brutal new lawman arrives, forcing the family to defend its livelihood against escalating intimidation and violence.

title: The Boy
plot: A young American woman accepts a nanny job at an isolated English estate, only to discover that her eight-year-old charge is a life-sized doll. When strange events begin, she must decide whether to follow the family’s strict rules and uncover what is really happening.

crew.name: Kaj Steveman
crew.role: Visual Effects Producer, Senior Visual Effects Supervisor

title: Hypnotic
plot: A detective investigating reality-bending crimes is drawn into a mystery surrounding his missing daughter. His search uncovers mind manipulation, shifting perceptions, and a secret government program, forcing him to question whom he can trust and what is real.

title: Color Out of Space
plot: A family retreats to a remote New England farm, hoping for a quieter life. After a meteorite crashes nearby and dissolves into the earth, an alien force begins warping the land, animals, and the family themselves, leaving them to face increasingly strange and disturbing changes.

title: New Police Story
plot: A disgraced police inspector, haunted after his unit is wiped out by a thrill-seeking gang, turns to alcohol and loses his confidence. With help from a young new partner carrying troubles of his own, he returns to the case and pursues the ruthless criminals responsible.

title: Osiris
plot: A military team is abducted mid-operation by a mysterious spacecraft and awakens aboard an alien vessel. Trapped in an unfamiliar environment, they become prey to a relentless extraterrestrial race and must fight their way through a brutal struggle for survival.

title: Don Jon
plot: A New Jersey bartender follows a strict routine of work, workouts, church, partying, casual sex, and pornography. When he begins pursuing a glamorous woman while confronting his unrealistic expectations about intimacy, an unexpected connection encourages him to reconsider what happiness and genuine relationships might require.

title: The Grey
plot: After a plane crash strands a group of oil workers in the Alaskan wilderness, a skilled huntsman tries to guide the survivors toward safety. As freezing conditions and a relentless wolf pack close in, their journey becomes a harsh test of courage, endurance, and the will to keep going.

title: Peppermint
plot: After her husband and daughter are murdered, a grieving mother disappears and rebuilds herself into a determined vigilante. Returning years later, she hunts those responsible while evading authorities, pursuing a personal form of justice through a relentless series of confrontations.

title: Sahara
plot: A seasoned treasure hunter and his wisecracking partner search the African desert for a long-lost ironclad battleship rumored to hold treasure. Their mission takes a dangerous turn when they encounter a determined scientist fleeing a warlord while investigating a deadly illness spreading through the region.

title: Jeepers Creepers 2
plot: When a school bus breaks down on a deserted road, a group of high school athletes becomes trapped with a relentless winged creature hunting them. As fear and tensions rise inside the bus, an determined father pursues the monster, hoping to rescue the stranded passengers and settle a personal score.

title: Asterix & Obelix: The Middle Kingdom
plot: Two lifelong Gallic friends travel to China to help a princess rescue the Empress and protect her land from a scheming prince. Their overseas adventure brings familiar comic heroes into a new setting filled with battles, playful humor, and cultural clashes.

title: 47 Meters Down
plot: Two sisters on vacation in Mexico become trapped in a shark cage on the ocean floor after a diving trip goes wrong. With limited air, dangerous waters, and rescue far above, they must find a way back to the surface before time runs out.

title: Automata
plot: After environmental catastrophes devastate Earth, humanity survives in a walled city while robots perform essential work under strict rules. An insurance investigator examining a seemingly altered machine uncovers a mystery that challenges human control and raises questions about artificial life, evolution, and the future of both species.

title: Beautiful Disaster
plot: A college freshman tries to leave a troubled past behind while navigating an intense attraction to a notorious campus fighter. When circumstances bring them into close quarters, a playful challenge pushes their complicated relationship in unexpected directions.

title: The Descent: Part 2
plot: A traumatized survivor emerges alone from an Appalachian cave system, unable to explain what happened or why she is covered in blood. Authorities bring her back underground with a rescue team to search for missing companions, forcing her to confront the terrifying creatures and memories connected to the caves.

crew.name: Peter Wignall
crew.role: Second Unit Director of Photography, Camera Operator, Steadicam Operator

title: Alienoid
plot: In the late Goryeo era, mystical seekers pursue a legendary holy sword while, in 2022, people track an alien prisoner sealed inside a human body. Their separate quests collide when a portal connecting different times opens.

crew.name: Jay Seung Jaegal
crew.role: VFX Supervisor, Visual Effects Art Director

title: Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs
plot: A group of princes transformed into dwarfs searches for a young woman’s magical red shoes, hoping to break the spell. Their quest becomes difficult as they face obstacles and learn that appearances may not tell the whole story.

title: Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants
plot: As a powerful northern army advances westward and threatens a southern kingdom, rival martial arts schools must overcome internal divisions. A young warrior raised among the invaders faces a difficult choice between loyalty to his upbringing and devotion to his homeland, joining fellow fighters to defend a besieged city.

title: The Legend of Ochi
plot: In a remote village on Carpathia, a shy farm girl raised to fear the elusive ochi discovers a wounded baby creature. She leaves home to return it to its family, facing danger and challenging the beliefs that have shaped her village and her own place within it.

title: Ratchet & Clank
plot: When a dangerous space captain threatens the galaxy, an ambitious mechanic and a defective robot join an elite team of defenders. Together, they face an army of killer machines and race across the stars to protect the universe.

title: The Exorcism of God
plot: A priest serving in Mexico is revered by many parishioners, but a failed exorcism has left him burdened by a devastating secret. When an opportunity arises to confront the evil connected to his past, he must summon the courage to face it once more.

title: The Enforcer
plot: In Miami, a longtime enforcer learns that his criminal employer has entered cyber sex trafficking. When a young runaway he has befriended becomes endangered, he turns against the organization he helped build and risks everything to protect her.

title: Holy Night: Demon Hunters
plot: When a devil-worshipping criminal network throws Seoul into chaos, the police seek help from a trio of unconventional supernatural hunters. As a desperate exorcism draws them into danger, the team must confront demonic forces and work together to restore order.

title: Marked Men
plot: A rebellious tattoo artist and a responsible pre-med student are drawn together despite their very different lives. After a memorable birthday night exposes their hidden feelings, they must navigate family expectations, past pain, and commitment fears while trying to build a relationship without losing themselves.

title: Safe House
plot: After a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles, six government agents take refuge in a high-security safe house. Cut off from help and facing threats outside, they must work together to survive while suspicion grows that one of them may be connected to the attack.

title: Muzzle: City of Wolves
plot: A police officer seeking a peaceful family life sees that stability shattered when a gang attacks those closest to him. Paired with a new K-9 partner, he pursues justice through a dangerous criminal underworld while confronting the lasting weight of his past.

title: Gunner
plot: During a camping trip meant to rebuild a family bond, a war veteran must rescue his two sons after they are kidnapped by violent bikers. The boys’ accidental discovery of a large drug operation draws the family into a dangerous fight against a ruthless criminal gang.

title: Off the Grid
plot: A brilliant scientist retreats to a quiet rural community after a powerful company attempts to weaponize his revolutionary technology. When a team is dispatched to track him down, his survival skills and ingenuity turn the pursuit into a dangerous game of cat and mouse.

title: Splitsville
plot: When a good-natured man is blindsided by his wife’s request for a divorce, he turns to close friends for support. Their open marriage introduces him to an unexpected world of romantic boundaries, jealousy, and crossed lines, sending both couples into chaotic and absurd relationship turmoil.

title: Dangal
plot: A determined father trains his two daughters to become world-class wrestlers, challenging poverty, social expectations, and prejudice against girls. Their demanding journey tests family bonds while pursuing a dream few around them believe is possible.

title: Inheritance
plot: After a wealthy family patriarch dies, his wife and daughter receive an unexpected inheritance that exposes a deeply troubling secret. As the daughter investigates, she is forced to confront hidden family history, difficult moral choices, and threats that could damage the family’s reputation and safety.

title: The Carpenter's Son
plot: In Roman-era Egypt, a carpenter, his wife, and their child hide in a remote village while supernatural forces close in. As the child begins questioning his identity and strange abilities, the family faces growing fear, spiritual conflict, and an uncertain destiny.

title: Guns Akimbo
plot: An ordinary man is forced into a violent online death game after his hands are fitted with guns. To survive and save his kidnapped former girlfriend, he must face a heavily armed, far more experienced opponent while navigating a chaotic city.

title: Nefarious
plot: On the day of an inmate’s scheduled execution, a psychiatrist is brought in to determine whether he is mentally fit to face it. During their tense evaluation, the inmate claims to be a demon and predicts that the psychiatrist will commit three murders before their session ends.

title: The Outpost
plot: A small unit of U.S. soldiers stationed at a remote outpost in Afghanistan faces an overwhelming Taliban assault. As the isolated position comes under attack, the troops fight to defend one another and survive an intense, brutal battle based on true events.

title: I, Frankenstein
plot: Two centuries after his creation, a solitary creature is drawn into a hidden war between demons and gargoyle-like guardians. As both sides pursue him, he must decide where he stands while a threat to humanity grows.

title: Avengement
plot: During a prison furlough, a hardened criminal escapes his guards and returns to his old neighborhood. There, he confronts the people and criminal forces he believes helped shape him into a violent killer, setting off a gritty quest for revenge.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
plot: A young man raised in a village discovers extraordinary strength and a powerful connection to a distant kingdom. After meeting a determined warrior, he joins a dangerous mission to free a queen held captive for years, while uncovering secrets about his own origins and the royal conflict surrounding them.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
plot: A young man learns about his royal heritage and begins seeking answers about his family’s past. His journey unfolds alongside events from an earlier era, revealing the struggles, loyalties, and ambitions surrounding a powerful kingdom.

title: Spread
plot: A gigolo must contend with the prospect that he has found true love.

title: Jeepers Creepers III
plot: On the final day of a monster’s feeding spree, a skeptical officer joins a determined task force intent on stopping it. As the team closes in, the creature fights back with brutal attacks, forcing its enemies into a dangerous confrontation while hints about its mysterious origins remain just out of reach.

title: 40 Acres
plot: In a famine-ravaged near future, a family descended from Black farmers who settled in rural Canada fights to protect its generations-old farm. As food and farmland become increasingly scarce, the family must make a desperate stand against a ruthless militia determined to seize their home.

title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
plot: After witnessing a family tragedy linked to a Santa costume, a troubled drifter becomes a seasonal killer who targets people he deems wicked. His violent mission takes an unexpected turn when he arrives in a small town, meets a young woman, and begins questioning the darkness guiding his choices.

title: Brave Citizen
plot: A former boxing champion now working as a high-school teacher witnesses intolerable violence and decides to fight back. Adopting a mask and stepping beyond her cautious routine, she seeks justice while facing the risks of challenging abuse and entrenched power.

title: Simulant
plot: After losing her husband, a grieving woman brings home an android designed to resemble him. As the android struggles to earn her affection, a government agent pursues simulants that have developed independent awareness, while a hacker works to challenge the rules controlling them.

title: Proximity
plot: A young NASA scientist is abducted by extraterrestrials, but skepticism from others drives him to search for proof. His investigation leads him toward fellow witnesses, government attention, and a wider mystery involving the visitors and their interest in Earth.

title: Muzzle
plot: After a K-9 officer loses his beloved partner in a shocking shooting, he struggles with grief and anger while pursuing answers. His investigation leads him through Los Angeles’s troubled streets and toward a dangerous conspiracy involving drugs, police corruption, and exploited service dogs.

title: Hijack 1971
plot: In 1971, a former fighter pilot working for a commercial airline faces a terrifying crisis when a passenger plane is hijacked. With the crew and passengers trapped at high altitude, he must stay focused and find a way to protect everyone aboard.

title: The Nut Job 2: Nutty by Nature
plot: When a greedy mayor plans to replace a beloved park with an amusement park, a squirrel and a group of animal friends must return to their natural home and work together to protect it. Their fight brings lively action, comic misadventures, and a message about friendship and teamwork.

title: Murder Report
plot: A serial killer offers a special interview to a veteran reporter desperate for a major scoop. Their restrained psychological duel unfolds through probing conversations, challenging assumptions about guilt, empathy, justice, and society’s expectations while steadily building an unsettling sense of tension.

title: Bambi: The Reckoning
plot: After a car wreck strands a mother and her son near a remote woodland, they become targets of a mutated deer consumed by grief and revenge. As the creature pursues them and their relatives, other transformed animals and a group hunting the beast add further danger to their struggle for survival.

title: Take Cover
plot: A burned-out professional sniper and his partner are trapped in an all-glass penthouse by a lethal rival. With attackers closing in and almost no protection from gunfire, they must use their skills and ingenuity to survive, uncover what is happening, and find a way out.

title: Cash Out
plot: A retired master thief is drawn back into crime when his younger brother attempts a dangerous bank heist alone. Trapped inside with hostages and surrounded by authorities, he must rely on his experience to outwit the threat while confronting unresolved feelings for a former lover.

title: Mojin: The Lost Legend
plot: Three retired tomb raiders leave their former lives behind and settle in New York. When they are asked to return to the dangerous profession to investigate the loss of someone close to them, they reunite and venture toward an ancient mystery filled with traps, supernatural threats, and buried secrets.

title: Fortress
plot: A top-secret resort shelters retired intelligence officers, but the sanctuary comes under attack when criminals break in seeking revenge against one resident. As danger spreads through the compound, a retired operative and his son must work together to protect the people inside.

title: The Point Men
plot: When tourists are taken hostage by an extremist group in Afghanistan, a skilled diplomat is sent to negotiate their release. After his efforts fail and the crisis turns deadly, he must join forces with a Middle East specialist, putting aside their differences to race against time and save the remaining hostages.

title: Alienoid: The Return to the Future
plot: A determined young woman must return to the future and stop alien prisoners from escaping human hosts. Trapped in the distant past, she joins forces with an uneasy companion who senses a strange presence within him, while heroes across centuries race to prevent a catastrophic explosion.

title: London Calling
plot: After a job goes wrong, a struggling hitman flees the UK and tries to find his way back home. To earn that chance, he must take his crime boss’s awkward teenage son along on a dangerous assignment and teach him about growing up.

title: Sword Master
plot: A powerful swordsman, exhausted by violence, abandons his former life to wander as a vagrant and seek peace. When turmoil reaches the quiet community where he hides, he must confront his past and recover the will to wield his sword once more.

title: Beautiful Wedding
plot: After waking up married following a wild night in Las Vegas, a young couple heads to Mexico with friends while fleeing trouble. Their improvised honeymoon becomes a chaotic string of misunderstandings, outrageous situations, and relationship challenges as they try to make sense of their sudden marriage.

title: Project Y
plot: Two friends trapped in dangerous lives work toward saving enough money to start over. When their plans collapse, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold, pushing them into one final, high-stakes gamble that could change everything.

title: The Collective
plot: A group of vigilante assassins targets a sophisticated human-trafficking network protected by powerful billionaires. When an experienced operative becomes compromised, the organization entrusts its crucial mission to a rookie assassin, who must confront dangerous criminals while proving himself in the field.

title: Xeno
plot: A troubled teenage girl forms an unexpected bond with an alien that crash-lands near her desert home. As authorities pursue the creature and tensions rise within her family, she must protect her new companion while facing threats at school and uncovering a mystery linking their worlds.

title: The Jester 2
plot: On Halloween night, a teenage magician encounters a sinister supernatural killer whose deadly tricks turn illusion into reality. As the night unfolds, she must rely on her own ingenuity to survive a barrage of theatrical, blood-soaked attacks and confront the mystery behind the killer’s magic.

title: Witchboard
plot: A young couple in New Orleans discovers a cursed spirit board that unleashes possession, deception, and supernatural danger. As dark forces close in, the pair must confront the board’s frightening history and survive its deadly influence.

title: Autumn and the Black Jaguar
plot: A teenager who grew up in the Amazon returns from New York City after learning that her beloved jaguar may be in danger. Joined by an unlikely companion, she journeys through the rainforest to protect her animal friend and help defend her childhood community from traffickers.

title: Valiant One
plot: After a helicopter crashes on the North Korean side of the border amid rising tensions, the surviving soldiers must protect a civilian technology specialist and navigate hostile territory. Cut off from U.S. military support, they are forced to rely on teamwork and determination to find a way out.

title: First Moon
plot: A young waitress is kidnapped by a religious group convinced they can purge a violent curse from her before the next full moon. Trapped in an isolated facility, she faces fear, pain, and a race against time to survive.

title: Second Life
plot: 28 years ago, Liang gives birth to a boy named "Little Bean Jelly" in prison. When the kid turns one, the mother and son lose contact. Years later, Green Dragon Group's henchman "Ghost" is ambushed during a mission and becomes blind. When Liang is released from prison, she meets Ghost. One wants only to complete the assassination, while the other wants to make amends to rebuild their mother-son relationship. By an unexpected combination of circumstances, this mother and son help each other redeem themselves and return to the right path.

title: Calibre 9
plot: In a French town riddled with corruption, Yann, a naive urban planner comes into ownership of a 9mm handgun possessed by the soul of Sarah, a murdered prostitute. Working together they will eliminate the criminals one by one, seeking to restore order in the city by hunting down the man at the head of the pact of corruption, the mayor himself.

title: Half Ticket
plot: Two young slum brothers are fascinated with the arrival of a new pizza shop in their locality, but getting in is harder than they thought.

title: Vaazha II
plot: Four close friends are labeled troublemakers by the adults around them, from family to school leaders. As they edge into adulthood under heavy social pressure, they set out on an emotional journey toward self-discovery and acceptance, learning to take responsibility and define success on their own terms.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
plot: Set in the 1970s, a fierce rebel rises from hardship to challenge brutal control over a gold mine in Kolar Gold Fields. As rival forces compete for power, his ambition and defiance turn him into a symbol of hope for oppressed workers.

title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
plot: When terrorists seize a dangerous nuclear site and threaten catastrophe, a decommissioned supersoldier is brought back for one last mission. He must confront an unstoppable next-generation warrior and a dangerous figure from his past while trying to survive a heavily armed stronghold.

title: Universal Soldier: Day of Reckoning
plot: After his family is killed during a home invasion, a widower awakens from a coma and pursues those he believes are responsible. His search draws him into a brutal conflict with enhanced soldiers and a mysterious figure challenging their conditioning, while he begins to question what he remembers.

title: A Company Man
plot: A contract killer grows disillusioned with his profession after sparing two would-be victims. When he tries to leave the assassination company, its members make clear that walking away will not be simple, forcing him to confront the dangerous consequences of his choice.

title: Gaia
plot: Deep in an ancient forest, an injured park ranger encounters a father and son living far from civilization. As strange growths and unsettling discoveries emerge around them, her routine mission becomes a fight for survival against a mysterious force tied to the natural world.

title: Between Worlds
plot: A struggling truck driver still grieving his family encounters a woman with unusual spiritual abilities. She asks for his help reaching her comatose daughter, but the attempt unleashes a disturbing supernatural conflict that draws him into questions of identity, desire, and unfinished business.

title: Wardriver
plot: A hacker who targets banks rather than individuals is forced into a dangerous scheme that puts an innocent woman in the crosshairs of a criminal syndicate. Racing through the city to repair the damage, he must confront his strict moral code and the consequences of hiding behind a screen.

title: Man Up
plot: A single woman, worn down by failed matchmaking attempts, is mistaken for someone else's blind date by a recently divorced man. Rather than correct him, she goes along with the misunderstanding, leading them into an unexpectedly chaotic, funny evening across London.

title: 88 Minutes
plot: A renowned forensic psychiatrist who helped convict a notorious serial killer receives a chilling message saying he has less than 90 minutes to live. As a new murder echoes the earlier crimes, he races to uncover who is targeting him while suspicion falls in every direction.

title: Jai Bhim
plot: A pregnant woman from a tribal community desperately searches for her husband after he disappears from police custody. A determined human-rights lawyer takes up her case, confronting police abuse, discrimination, and a deeply unjust system as they fight to uncover the truth and seek justice.

title: Adipurush
plot: In a mythic ancient kingdom, a noble prince and his brother journey with a powerful monkey army to an island ruled by a formidable king. Their mission is to rescue the prince’s wife, who has been abducted, leading to a sweeping conflict between opposing forces.

title: Becky
plot: A troubled teenager's weekend at a lake house with her father turns dangerous when a group of convicts invades. Forced to rely on her knowledge of the surroundings, resourcefulness, and determination, she fights to protect herself and her family in a violent struggle for survival.

title: Rang De Basanti
plot: A carefree group of university friends is drawn into a film about freedom fighters. After a friend’s tragic death linked to government corruption, their outlook changes, inspiring them to confront injustice and take responsibility for the country they call home.

title: Drishyam
plot: When a family faces criminal charges, a resourceful father uses his street smarts and knowledge of films to protect his loved ones and outmaneuver a determined investigation. As pressure mounts, careful planning turns the case into a tense battle of wits.

title: Sita Ramam
plot: A rebellious student in London must return to Pakistan to settle an unexpected debt after her grandfather’s death. His final request sends her on a letter-delivery mission connected to a soldier and a mysterious woman, beginning a journey through romance, memory, and a long-hidden story.

title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
plot: A refined young man returns from college to reconnect with his stern steamboat-captain father, who expected a tougher son. As tensions rise between rival boat owners and romance complicates matters, the young man faces a series of mishaps before a violent storm puts everyone in danger.

title: Redemption Day
plot: When a veteran’s wife is kidnapped by terrorists for ransom, he races against time to bring her home. His rescue mission takes him into a dangerous conflict involving powerful forces, testing his courage, determination, and battlefield experience.

title: T-34
plot: During World War II, a determined tank crew is captured and later forced to use a damaged T-34 in dangerous training exercises. With limited resources and mounting pressure, they rely on courage, teamwork, and an audacious plan to survive captivity and the battles ahead.

title: Please Stand By
plot: A young autistic woman leaves her caregiver to deliver her 500-page script to a writing competition in Hollywood. Guided by an imagined science-fiction mentor and determined to prove herself, she faces an unpredictable journey filled with humor, setbacks, and emotional discoveries.

title: Ghajini
plot: After a violent attack leaves him unable to form lasting memories, a wealthy man pursues revenge for his girlfriend’s death. He relies on photographs, handwritten notes, and tattoos to track his target while piecing together the romance and tragedy that shaped his mission.

title: The Lunchbox
plot: A mistaken lunch delivery connects a young housewife in an unhappy marriage with a lonely older office worker nearing retirement. Through handwritten notes tucked into the lunchbox, they share hopes, regrets, and companionship, creating an intimate bond that gradually challenges the boundaries of their everyday lives.

title: Sholay
plot: After a devastating attack on his family, a retired police officer recruits two small-time outlaws to help protect a village and capture a ruthless bandit. Their mission brings together action, humor, friendship, romance, and musical spectacle in a landmark Hindi western.

title: The Beast
plot: In a near future where strong emotions are viewed as dangerous, a woman undergoes a procedure designed to erase painful feelings by exploring her past lives. Across different eras, she encounters a man who feels strangely familiar, drawing her into an uncertain journey through love, memory, identity, and anxiety.

crew.name: Bertrand Bonello
crew.role: Director, Writer, Producer, Original Music Composer

title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
plot: A lively young man from a traditional Punjabi family falls for an accomplished woman from a cultured Bengali household. To test whether their relationship can bridge their sharply different backgrounds, they spend time living with each other’s families, confronting clashing values, expectations, and ideas about love, respect, and marriage.

title: Kaithi
plot: A man released on parole hopes to meet his daughter, but a major drug operation pulls him into a dangerous night. Working with an injured police officer, he must help protect unconscious officers while criminals close in and another group fights to survive.

title: Drishyam 2
plot: Seven years after the events of the first film, a family continues to live with the trauma of that night. When a renewed investigation brings fresh pressure, they must confront the threat together in this tense story about protection, fear, and the lasting consequences of the past.

title: Friend Request
plot: A popular college student accepts a friend request from a lonely classmate, drawing the newcomer into her social circle. When the relationship becomes unsettling and the request is withdrawn, a disturbing curse begins to threaten the student’s friendships and safety.

title: Koi... Mil Gaya
plot: A young man with a childlike mind lives with his mother and faces bullying and isolation. After he and a new friend encounter a stranded extraterrestrial, their lives change as they form a bond, explore unexpected possibilities, and try to protect their unusual companion.

title: Flashbacks of a Fool
plot: An aging Hollywood star, lost in a self-destructive life of excess, receives news that his childhood best friend has died. Returning in memory to a seaside town in 1970s Britain, he revisits the friendships, romances, mistakes, and painful events that shaped the person he became.

title: Follow Me
plot: A social media star travels to Moscow with friends to create daring content for a growing audience. Their escape-room adventure plunges the group into a dangerous world of mystery and excess, forcing them to confront blurred boundaries between online entertainment and real-life survival.

title: Breaking Surface
plot: Two half sisters embark on a winter diving trip in Northern Norway, but a sudden rockslide traps them in a dangerous underwater situation. As conditions worsen, they must find a way to survive the cold, limited air, and hazards around them.

title: Krrish
plot: In Singapore, a sheltered young man with extraordinary abilities is drawn into romance, danger, and a search for his family’s lost legacy. After circumstances push him to hide his identity behind a mask, he becomes a masked hero and faces a powerful threat while trying to protect others.

title: Kalashnikov
plot: After being seriously injured in battle, a young tank commander recovers in a hospital and cannot return to the front. During his rehabilitation, the self-taught inventor turns to engineering, developing early designs for a weapon that will become widely known around the world.

title: The Beauty Inside
plot: A furniture designer wakes each day in a different body, making ordinary life unpredictable. After falling for a woman he meets through work, he must find a way to build a relationship despite his ever-changing appearance and the challenges it creates.

title: Raid

title: The Vigil
plot: A man takes an overnight job watching over a deceased member of his former religious community, reciting prayers and guarding the body before burial. As unsettling events unfold, he must face growing fear, painful memories, and a malevolent entity that seems to feed on his distress.

title: Border

Inspired by the Battle of Longewala, the film combines battlefield pressure with glimpses of the soldiers’ personal lives and relationships.

title: Be with You
plot: A grieving father and his young son hold on to a promise that their loved one will return with the rainy season. When she reappears, their reunion is complicated by her lack of memories, creating a tender family story filled with love, sadness, and hope.

title: Hero

title: Yakuza Princess

title: Cocktail
plot: A shy, traditional woman moves from India to London after marriage and finds shelter with a confident party girl. Their lives become further complicated when a charming flirt joins their household, creating an emotionally charged romantic triangle.

title: Johnny Jumper
plot: A cable operator with an unusual talent for becoming unseen is drawn into an investigation after a local politician disappears. As he follows the clues, the case grows beyond a straightforward kidnapping and exposes a much larger mystery.

title: Find Your Friends
plot: A carefree girls’ trip takes a disturbing turn when hostile locals intensify tensions and buried trauma resurfaces. As toxic dynamics drive the friends apart, their getaway descends into a dangerous nightmare fueled by anger and revenge.

title: Speed Demon

title: An Evening Song (for three voices)

title: Subedaar
plot: Haunted by loss and distant from his daughter, a retired soldier struggles to adjust to civilian life. After a reckless act reopens old wounds, he must draw on his discipline and courage to confront a dangerous threat that reaches into his family.

title: Micro Budget
plot: A mockumentary about an absolute moron attempting to make an independent film.

title: TT for Life

title: Columbine Shooting: Minute by Minute

title: Tube-E Movie

title: Euphoria

title: New Jersey Devil
plot: 16-year-old Sophie is in the process of being adopted when a sinister force out of New Jersey folklore begins to torment her new family.

title: Blue Skies on Mars

title: One Two Cha Cha Chaa
plot: Fuel up, gear up, and level up for the wildest, wackiest road trip of all time. Expect nonstop energy and laugh-out-loud chaos as the journey kicks off.

title: The Knock Knock Man

Now hunted one by one, the friends must uncover the dark origins of the legend and find a way to banish the spirit before the knocking comes for them next.—Joseph Mazzaferro

title: The Conspiracists

title: Land Looters
plot: Part travelogue and part sensitive investigation, the movie tells the universal story of people who refuse to be erased, reminding us that defending the Earth means defending life.

title: Dark Alliance: The Next Generation
plot: A covert space program in chaos: the old 20 and Back boss fades, the new guys fight for the alien spotlight, and the whole saga gets buried under drama, deception, and a fresh batch of self-proclaimed space heroes. Who will reign supreme?

title: The House on Haunted Grounds
plot: A group enters a notorious haunted house tied to possession and murder, hoping to make it through the night. When no one returns, the only trace left behind is the footage they captured inside.

title: Cuba: Coocuyo Remix

Cuba – Coocuyo Remix is a neorealist comedy that observes their everyday life without filters, moving between clichés and moments of truth, and transforming daily existence into a collective portrait. The film follows both the pioneers and the new generation of Cuba’s electronic music scene, showing how their dedication continues to shape the island’s nightlife culture, in a story where music gives way to the full force of reality.

title: Kayikci
plot: In 2085, a grieving mother hires a young ritualist (Kayikci) to bring her son back to life inside an isolated villa where reality fractures, and a forbidden resurrection unleashes a terrifying night : A night of ritual-driven surge of unease and escalating suspense.

title: Complicated Christmas

plot: Driven by rage and regret, Xavier embarks on a journey to avenge the murder of his wife and son. By any means necessary.

plot: A US Marshal gets stuck on Christmas Eve protecting a pregnant fugitive from a bounty hunter and a hitman Santa with his henchmen of elves.

In present day Manhattan, Cassie Cole, a hillbilly True Crime blogger (from the Deep South), continually re-lives Pauline's murder, discovering that she is Pauline's reincarnated soul, and eventually solving a decades-old crime.

When the adults suddenly forget the missing child ever existed, he teams up with new friends to investigate the town’s unsettling traditions and uncover the truth before it is too late.

title: Inthralled

title: A Love Letter To The Beatles

title: Boss
plot: An aspiring restaurant franchise owner is unexpectedly nominated to lead a gang, but he wants to hand the role to a former boss’s grandson, who dreams of becoming a tango dancer. As both candidates try to lose the election, an unwelcome troublemaker enters the chaotic contest.

plot: Sean and Jessica followed different paths in high school but connected over a mixtape in theater class. A chance encounter at their twenty year reunion sends them on a night of self-discovery in this adult coming-of-age drama.

plot: While spending Christmas with her best friend’s family, Tessa falls for her friend’s brother and faces potential heartache when his ex arrives.

plot: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion is an inspiring sports drama that chronicles the extraordinary life of Arjun Chakravarthy, a determined kabaddi player who represented India in the 1980s.

As he explores the building and its forbidden fourth floor, he finds disturbing links to his foster-child upbringing.

title: Tanvi: The Great
plot: An autistic young woman learns of her late father’s dream to salute the flag at Siachen Glacier. Facing barriers that can exclude neurodivergent people from military service, she takes on a determined journey to complete his mission.

title: Nikita Roy
plot: A rational woman doubts supernatural claims until she investigates the mysterious death of her brother. As her search deepens, she uncovers a troubling link to a religious cult that challenges what she believes.

title: Aankhon ki Gustaakhiyan
plot: A blind musician and a theatre artist meet on a train while travelling through the Himalayas. Their connection grows into love as they look beyond appearances, but changing circumstances test whether their relationship can endure.

title: I'll Play Mother
plot: After the death of their birth mother, two young children are placed in the care of prospective adopter parents, however, it's not long before the new family begin to question if something more sinister is at play.

title: Other

plot: After a personal tragedy, a grieving teenager moves to a small Florida town and struggles to fit in with an unfamiliar family and a troubling local crowd. When a cruel act draws the attention of a nightmare-like force tied to bullying and revenge, survival depends on facing guilt and breaking the curse.

title: Maargan
plot: A seasoned police officer haunted by tragedy investigates a complex case involving a mysterious swimmer and a series of killings. As hidden connections emerge, he races against time to identify the threat and uncover the darker forces behind the crimes.

plot: In this thrilling, unique, and sometimes hilarious UFO documentary, tantalising discoveries emerge while delving into Britain’s own Roswell—the 1980 Rendlesham UFO incident where a mysterious craft was reportedly seen landing near a U.S. airbase. As the investigation revisits the original event, the film also chronicles the strange encounters reported in Rendlesham Forest ever since; weird UFO sightings, floating orbs of light, and encounters with terrifying cryptid creatures.

title: Universal
plot: During a romantic getaway at a remote cabin, two academics are suddenly approached by a stranger who needs their help. What begins as an intimate break quickly turns into a high-stakes situation tied to a potentially world-changing discovery.

title: Detective Sherdil

plot: A driven businesswoman is chasing the biggest contract of her career, but a crucial meeting abroad comes with an unexpected expectation: her partners only trust people with families. With no time to change plans, she brings a coworker along as her pretend fiancé, and they must keep up the act under pressure.

title: Jarann
plot: A family faces supernatural chaos when witchcraft and ancient beliefs invade their remote village. A woman must uncover the truth about dark rituals and herself as fear and madness grow.

title: Bare Skin
plot: Victims of extreme trauma are invited to a group therapy session to share their experiences in a safe setting, but as their stories are told, an unsettling truth reveals that they may all be connected in their misfortune.

title: Ghatikachalam
plot: Kaushik, a timid medical student, finds himself battling not only his inner demons but also a sinister entity named Ghatikachalam that whispers through shadows and feeds on his fears. As his nights turn sleepless and his grip on reality begins to shatter, his family resorts to ancient spiritual rites to save him from a force far beyond their understanding.

title: The Wilde Girls
plot: In the year 1932, in the heart of the great depression, two clueless socialite heiresses with zero survival skills are tricked into moving to Washington State from millionaire's row Manhattan. After accidentally killing a hit man sent after them, they find themselves lost in the wilderness with a price on their heads. An unenthusiastic alliance with a misanthropic mountain man with a dark past may be their only chance for survival.

title: Interrogation
plot: When a retired judge is found dead in his house, the cops find 4 suspects who visited him on the day of the murder. Soon, each confess to their reasons for hating the man. Who is the real killer?

title: Tim Travers and the Time Traveler's Paradox
plot: A scientist creates a time machine and kills their younger self to see what would happen. And that self-obsessed, misanthropic, mad genius of a scientist is Tim Travers. And the universe was bad enough with only one of him.

title: Square Heads
plot: Brave and his friends, Four Eyes and Freckle, end up spending a fortune online after a few careless clicks, which throws Brave’s father into complete chaos. Hoping to fix what happened, Brave brings home an old watch he bought as a present. Out of nowhere, the watch activates and pulls the trio into a strange and surreal world. There they find themselves working for Ruhi, a strict and demanding boss who makes them earn every cent. To get back home, the kids have to stay alert, stick together and understand what the watch has dragged them into.

title: Deadly Escape
plot: After escaping from a maximum-security prison, Freda Maxwell, a woman convicted of murdering her  abusive father, is desperate to stay ahead of the law. When she kidnaps Drew Peterson, a seemingly innocent med  student, to aid her getaway, her plan takes a horrifying turn. Drew’s polite facade unravels, revealing a dangerous  predator with dark intentions. As Freda navigates her fight for freedom, she finds herself trapped in a psychological battle with a man who views her  as a pawn in his own twisted game. With both the police and Drew closing in, Freda must confront her haunted past  and summon every ounce of will to outsmart her captor and uncover the truth that could save her—or seal her fate forever

title: Sarangapani Jathakam
plot: Sarangapani, a man who finds comfort in the guidance of horoscopes, sets off on a turbulent journey that forces him to confront some hard truths about himself and his life.

Together, the unlikely partners pursue the missing woman, confronting uncertainty while gradually finding purpose and connection through their amateur investigation.

She's convinced her award is a platform to share this vision as a warning to the world. Leni's family and friends are worried for her reputation as the party lights up with wild ideas and unusual images.

title: Where There Is Love, There Is No Darkness
plot: An undocumented Fulani delivery man struggles to navigate the challenges of life in Paris while striving to support his family in Senegal. Entangled in a smuggling ring, he faces tough choices that will determine their future and his own survival.

plot: Arjun, an IPS aspirant turned kind-hearted gangster, learns that Pathaan, a notorious terrorist, wants to exact revenge on his principled mother Vyjayanthi, an honest IPS officer, and sets out to protect Vyjayanthi and their bond is put to the test.

title: Logout

title: It Feeds

title: Space Chasers

'Space Chasers' is an action-adventure travel documentary that takes viewers on an exhilarating journey through the captivating world of amateur astrophotography. Dr. Steven Swancoat, an Ob/Gyn turn filmmaker, travels the globe meeting and imaging with some of the world's greatest astrophotographers and all while trying to pull off an impossible "Astro Imaging" mission in Times Square New York.

title: The Door
plot: Mithra, an architect at a cursed job site gets entangled with a restless ghost, forcing her to uncover a decades-old murder linked to her own family.

This is the first full length feature documentary about the sport and art of flair bartending.

Set in modern India, it shifts political strategy from battlefields to classrooms and bureaucratic offices, drawing inspiration from an ancient teacher-and-ruler tradition.

title: Recipe for Love
plot: Two families entangled in a bad relationship for 30 years, resolving misunderstandings, healing each other's wounds, and ultimately being reborn as one family.

title: Space Gen: Chandrayaan
plot: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

title: Scum of the Brave
plot: In the mid-21st century, Tokyo's mafia can turn into ether-enhanced Demon Lords, and Braves hunt them down. Yashiro, the Grim Reaper, reluctantly takes a new apprentice named Aki Jogamine, a high school girl training to become a Brave. He soon finds himself dragged into one troublesome case after another. The supernatural story of a scumbag master and his self-proclaimed apprentice begins!

title: Jack-of-All-Trades, Party of None
plot: After being betrayed by a childhood friend and cast out of a heroic group, a once-loyal enchanter is branded a jack-of-all-trades. Setting out alone as an adventurer, he faces explosive battles and dangerous rivals while finding unexpected allies and working to prove his true worth.

title: Idol Child
plot: A top criminal lawyer and longtime fan sets out to prove her favorite idol’s innocence after he is suspected of murder. Balancing her demanding profession with her passionate fandom, she becomes drawn into a case that tests her judgment and commitment.

title: Nayanam
plot: Nayan, an ophthalmologist, runs an eye clinic for people in need. But he secretly carries out experiments in the clinic that help him look at the personal lives of his patients through their lenses.

title: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
plot: A paranormal investigator’s search for answers about unexplained phenomena draws him into a dangerous spiral. After his mysterious death, a journalist examines his eerie legacy, uncovering secrets that challenge the boundary between reality and the supernatural.

title: Aukaat Ke Bahar
plot: A small-town boxer earns a spot at an elite Delhi college to carry forward his brother’s dream. As he faces bullying, class prejudice, and campus politics, he’s pulled into a complicated romance that pushes him to fight for respect, love, and his own identity.

title: Heated Rivalry
plot: Two young hockey stars begin a secret relationship while competing at the highest level of their sport. Over several years, they balance ambition, public expectations, fear, and growing love as they gradually confront what their connection means to them.

title: Arafta
plot: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart.

title: Robin Hood
plot: After the Norman invasion of England, a Saxon forester’s son and a Norman lord’s daughter fall in love despite their divided worlds. Together, they confront corruption, stand up for justice, and seek to help restore peace across a troubled land in this modern reimagining of a classic legend.

title: Hal & Harper
plot: Two codependent siblings in Los Angeles struggle to move beyond childhood while their single father pushes them toward adulthood. As family grief and old wounds surface, they navigate messy relationships, difficult memories, and the challenge of supporting one another while trying to find their own paths.

title: Search: The Naina Murder Case
plot: A veteran cop gets mired in a high-profile murder case when a girl is found dead in a politician's car. With multiple suspects, how will she unmask the killer?

title: Room of Guilty Pleasure
plot: This overworked and underpaid teacher, Mr. Sasaki, has his whole life turned upside down when he stumbles upon the "Guilty Hole." He thinks it's a dream when he sees the student's shoe lockers have been transformed into selection panels... seeing one that catches his eye, he joking picks her... When she appears in his classroom in the middle of the night, throwing insults at him, but her eyes seem to linger on him, tinged with embarassment. "I'll finish this quickly so... Don't hold back, ok...?" Thus begins a forbidden relationship... Welcome to the Guilty Hole, where anything is allowed--

title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
plot: Hinako lives alone by the sea, quietly drifting through life after losing her family years ago. One day, a mermaid named Shiori saves her from a monster and says she’s come to eat her—just not yet. Until then, Shiori will stay by her side and keep her safe. In that moment, a deep hope swells in Hinako: Maybe this girl can finally grant her the ending she’s been waiting for.

title: The Hack
plot: Set between 2002 and 2012, this drama follows two intertwined real-life investigations: a journalist uncovering phone hacking at a powerful tabloid and a detective pursuing answers in an unsolved murder. Their separate efforts expose troubling connections involving the media, private surveillance, policing, and the pursuit of justice.

title: The Guest
plot: A cleaner struggling with everyday pressures is hired by a wealthy businesswoman and welcomed into an unfamiliar world of privilege. Their friendship gradually shifts into a tense psychological contest, exposing hidden motives, class tensions, and difficult choices as trust becomes increasingly uncertain.

title: The Rainmaker
plot: Fresh out of law school, a young attorney takes on a powerful courtroom rival while navigating complicated ties to a former law school partner. With help from an unconventional boss and a scruffy paralegal, the attorney investigates connected conspiracies surrounding a client’s son’s mysterious hospital death.

title: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
plot: With humour, absurdity and family cat and mouse at its center, this is a tale of family gangsters in a fictitious madhouse city, Bindiya. As the current Don is put behind bars, the gangster family's alliances shift, new love, friendships, and betrayals explode until Bindiya becomes a full-blown circus-where love is a deal, power is personal, and every one has a card and blood on their hands.

title: S Line
plot: A young woman who can see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers that her secret gift is no longer unique. When special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market, the ability begins affecting strangers’ lives and drawing them into dangerous situations.

title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
plot: When superstar adventurer Dennis gets booted from the world’s strongest party, he teams up with runaway Atelier to serve up his true passion—delicious cuisine. But this not-so-average eatery has not-so-average patrons. Dennis will battle his quirky customers’ troubles with his trusty butcher knife and wok. Visit Adventurer’s Restaurant and fill up your heart and stomach!

title: Takopi's Original Sin
plot: A cheerful alien arrives on Earth determined to spread happiness and helps a lonely fourth grader using strange devices. As the alien encounters the painful realities surrounding her and another troubled child, well-meaning attempts to help reveal that suffering and happiness are more complicated than expected.
